name: Eval pipeline: turn an accepted finding into an eval case, see it on the agent's Evals tab, see the seeded batch on the Eval Dashboard (SPEC-04 AC-113, AC-114, AC-115)
description: From seeded PR #482 open the Agent runs tab, accept the first finding ('Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit', expanded by default), click 'Turn into eval case' and confirm 'Eval case created' (AC-113). Then open /agents, open the Security Reviewer (ids are random per seed, so by click), switch to its Evals tab and confirm the new case is listed with its name and the 'must find' badge (AC-114). Finally open /eval and confirm the Security Reviewer row shows the newest seeded batch: 83% recall, 100% precision, 86% citation and '7/8 passed' (AC-115; the older seeded batch is 50%/75%/67%, 4/8). No model call, no chat. Casing: the dashboard metric headers are uppercase in the message file ('RECALL'), so waits use them as written. The list defaults to the 'needs review' filter, so 'All' is clicked first. Needs the SPEC-04 server seed (patches on #482, 8 Security Reviewer cases, 2 done batches): use e2e:hermetic. Mutates the DB (accepts a finding, creates a case), so on a reused dev DB the Accept click toggles an already accepted finding and the flow is not rerunnable.
